svg.title: Data model: home
svg.text: One encrypted SQLite database on the home device (the router, if it has an NPU, or a dedicated box). Images, fingerprints and face templates exist only here.
face_template: up to 8 templates per person registered with consent; deleted when the person withdraws consent. fingerprint: one vector for each of the thing’s 8 photos.
outbox: keeps events and alerts, as text, while offline; image analysis carries on without internet. thing, rule and person share the platform’s ids; the platform keeps their names and rules.
